normalization_plan.reason: The recipient parameter only exists to feed the _transfer destination argument.
The amount parameter is only consumed by _transfer validations and accounting.
The sender parameter is used solely to update balances inside _transferStandard.
tAmount is the sole input to the reflection value computation.
The bots_ array is iterated only to write the bots state mapping.
The local balance is immediately forwarded as the swap amount argument.
The local ETH balance is immediately forwarded to the fee distribution.
The feeAddr1 parameter is validated and assigned only inside the setter.
